scope: Unqualified combined full-cutover worktree over checked core170r. Native default source and zero runtime compatibility routes are staged; actual HTTP/TLS/platform qualification and final publication remain pending. Original core candidate/release remain intact.

policy.sourceFiles: Every src/**/*.ts file remains explicitly dev-oracle-owned and hash-bound. Its production/test role distinguishes Source implementation from oracle tests, not native runtime authority. Production and test hashes remain separate; neither grants runtime ownership.
policy.nativeFiles: Every project-owned native/src/**/*.rs, native/tests/**/*.rs and optional native/build.rs plus Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock and rust-toolchain.toml is hash-bound at seal. Dependency .cargo-home caches and target output are excluded. Inline cfg(test) modules are hashed but excluded from the narrow production placeholder check.
policy.routing: Each manifest tool is explicitly native-readonly, native-local, native-readonly-workflow, native-service or unimplemented. Fixed checked maps and exact schemas define declaration; immutable runtime profiles still restrict discovery/admission. Route changes require explicit --update --adopt-manifest-routes after review. The retained TypeScript Source is a development oracle only; native refusal never transfers to it.
policy.evidence: A seal detects drift and inventory omissions; it does not prove semantic parity, absence of all stubs, performance, delivered packaging, or native OBS behavior. Required differential and package checks remain separate.
policy.manualSnapshots: Opt-in LIST/CAPTURE and manual RESTORE; caller policy precedes snapshot selection including dryRun, missing selection stays offline, and valid selection is rechecked by the combined Service. Manual restore uses only the eight closed legacy snapshot mutations, one SerialRealtime nonhalting batch, strict complete-vector v3 receipts and no lifecycle/file/Stop authority. Unknown outcomes never authorize replay. The sole snapshot history owner is retained through actual publication and admitted restore planning/settlement. Snapshots are ordered observations, not an atomic OBS transaction or Stage receipt. Missing/replaced established history, corrupt JSON, unproven locks, unsafe paths, byte capacity and publication uncertainty refuse explicitly. Native never renames corrupt history away or steals an old lock based on age; these are conservative differences from the predecessor. Source read-only classification permits capture during a take; snapshot file publication borrows no recording receipt writer. The default owner caps history at 8 MiB and concrete capture at 4096 requests per batch, with the Service absolute deadline. Blocking filesystem calls are joined; a deadline does not prove a hard kernel-I/O latency bound.
policy.propertyEnumeration: Dedicated guarded adapter only; absent from RawReadRequest. Reported source kind governs the exact predecessor guard; ScreenCaptureKit display_uuid/application always refuse and XComposite capture_window requires a nonempty string, while integer window properties skip the unsafe settings probe. Native additionally refuses changed canonical evidence at actual dispatch/result publication, without retry. Optional nullable arrays of record items preserve every valid response field; malformed shapes reproduce Source SDK output-validation messages within a 32 KiB diagnostic limit, above which native refuses explicitly.
policy.applySceneDomain: Typed pure planning and corrected continuation/final formatting only. The settings-order sidecar compares original parsed arguments before stripping and carries key lists only. Closed effects serialize descriptions and grant no dispatch, receipt, snapshot or recording authority. Dedicated two-stage effect custody is checked as a library primitive; retained Service/public admission remains separate.
policy.dynamicVisibility: Pure session-local registered/available/enabled state with immutable availability, including permanent Stream exclusion in Take/media profiles. Complete-availability Source registry/result checks are distinct from restricted native projection. Group facts retain known/available/registered/enabled counts. No public mode flag, dynamic schema, subscription, notification writer or effect permission is activated by this library. Test-only JSON is bound by the full frozen-source manifest. Actual Source controller descriptors/group covers/registration order are now exported into the already-bound tools.json under toolsets.dynamic; ordinary178 tools/static routes are unchanged. Modern listener routing and public visibility/publication composition remain unowned.
policy.applySceneReceipts: Strict identity-only V4 apply-scene-workflow metadata retains creation facts through continuation/change. Fixed serial-realtime creation halt=true/change halt=false. ACKed skipped suffix differs from proven notAttempted; no comments, subjects, settings, paths or response data are persisted. Unfinished/Unknown history blocks ordinary and restart admission and never resumes/replays. Only exact live validated Apply loans qualify for the existing public safety-Stop exception; Apply gains no Stop/Take/Generic/file authority.
policy.outputPublication: One physical writer. Existing 128 item credits bound queued/active ordinary lines or finite publication cursors; all retained serialized template bytes share the original 32 MiB pool through flush, without copied current lines. Multi-frame headers/templates have aggregate 4096 entry and 256 KiB header bounds. Each cursor additionally caps emitted frames at262144 and amplified bytes at256 MiB. These are representation/work limits, not caller Value graphs, allocator overhead, total RSS or bounded kernel-I/O latency. Reserve and seal before visibility commit; dropped reservations enqueue nothing. Cancelled completion waits retain writer-owned byte/frame/flush progress. Receiver death/abort rejects late enqueue and fails retained tickets without replay. No dynamic runtime mode is activated.
